displayedOrder.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: image-based visual concept of a desktop materials library for the Chinese university project 心域智链.
Concept name: 按页选材.
Create one realistic production-quality primary UI screen, exactly one independent concept, target dimensions 1440 x 1024. Full app content only, no browser/device frame. This is a visual design mock, not an implemented website.
Brief: The user is preparing an eight-page defense PPT and needs a richer, cohesive collection of reusable illustrations, direction icons, diagrams and evidence visuals. The main task is choose the current slide, see only a few suitable assets, preview a composition, and download the chosen material. The product is a PPT authoring materials library, not the mental-health support application itself.
Reference image 1 is the existing asset collection: use the loose human hand-drawn Open Doodles visual language and Phosphor line icons as actual grounding. Reference image 2 is the existing direction and mindmap collection: use these simple project relationships and AI flow structure. These are reference/moodboard images, not screenshots to paste wholesale. Do not imitate the old sparse preview sheets as the final product.
Existing design tokens: white background, #78558F warm purple primary, #604372 deeper purple, #E8B185 apricot, #8BA696 sage, #29332F ink, #56625C secondary. Calm, warm, human, refined, enough editorial character to feel carefully designed. No blue technology dashboard, neon gradients, decorative blobs, glassmorphism or emoji.
Structure: slender left navigation with heading 答辩素材 and eight clear slide names as a vertical working outline: 项目概览, 背景需求, 产品服务, AI实现, 湖北市场, 实施验证, 组织预算, 预期成果. Select 产品服务. In the main area a large title 为这一页挑选素材 and short supporting copy 师生沟通与记录查看. A modest search field 搜索适合本页的素材. Show four large, thoughtfully selected asset previews rather than an exhaustive inventory: warm human illustration of reading, student-teacher conversation concept, existing four-branch project mindmap, and existing appointment synthetic screenshot represented as a small realistic UI crop (clearly labelled 合成案例). A spacious bottom composition strip shows a clean slide thumbnail that combines one human illustration and two short task lists, with editable content areas depicted clearly. One primary button 下载选中素材, one secondary 预览放入PPT.
Use grouping, alignment, typography and whitespace before borders; minimal shadows. A collection can have preview tiles, but do not put panels inside panels or make every line a pill. The image thumbnails should feel rich, generous and visually distinct while maintaining one coherent hand-drawn human style. The library UI itself should be clean and precise.
Readable Simplified Chinese UI, 14–16 px body scale, strong type hierarchy. Include only essential labels and realistic content. No invented user statistics, customers, revenue, budgets, approved clinical effects, fake license verification or thousands-of-assets counts. New generated illustration thumbnails must not be labelled as real downloadable SVGs. Existing vector previews may retain SVG labels; mock imagery is only conceptual.
Current date anchor: 2026-10-27 Asia/Shanghai; do not include dates or time widgets. Preserve 8-slide scope without adding slide pages.
Render the entire single interface with no clipped content, no multiple concepts in one image, and no explanations outside the UI.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Concept name: 场景图库.
Create one independent high-fidelity Chinese desktop web-app screen for 心域智链的答辩PPT素材库, target dimensions 1440 x 1024, app content only without any browser chrome, device frame or screen mockup. This is visual ideation only, not a built product. Current date anchor 2026-10-27 Asia/Shanghai; show no dates, times, users, revenue or analytics.
User goal: quickly browse visually rich and coherent assets for an eight-page university project defense deck, compare illustrations and functional diagrams, then retrieve the relevant source. Keep the actual deck eight slides. This is a materials browser for the PPT creator, not the student mental-health product.
Input reference 1 role: existing collection of Open Doodles human illustrations, IRA alternatives and Phosphor line icons. Input reference 2 role: functional directional icons, original project mindmap, proposed AI flow and implementation route. Ground the visible asset subject matter and line style in these actual collections. Do not paste either reference sheet wholesale. Favor one consistent loose human hand-drawn illustration language from Open Doodles, with supporting Phosphor icons. No photorealistic images.
Visual system must follow existing project tokens: primarily pure white, restrained warm purple #78558F / #604372, apricot #E8B185, sage #8BA696, ink #29332F. Warm and human, art-directed and editorial. Precise legible Chinese typography, restrained surfaces, enough white space to make each artwork feel substantial. Avoid multicolored dashboard styling, giant promotional purple hero blocks, glass, floating blobs, gradients or decorative emoji.
Layout strategy: a wide editorial gallery with no left sidebar. Minimal horizontal brand header 心域智链 素材库, simple links 全部素材, 我的选材. A bold headline 为答辩找到合适的画面 and a wide modest search field 搜索人物、场景或流程. Under it, a plain horizontal category selector 人物场景, 功能图标, 思维导图, 方向流程, select 人物场景. One supporting row of restrained topical text: 学生陪伴, 师生沟通, 记录阅读, AI协作.
The main content is a spacious asymmetrical gallery: one large featured two-person student-teacher communication illustration at left on white with small apricot and sage details; alongside it two medium preview tiles: the existing person reading and the existing project mindmap. A lower strip can show just two useful examples: a proposed AI flow with its 拟建设 label and an implementation route with no invented weeks. Each item has a short meaningful Chinese title and an unobtrusive category; thumbnails dominate. No repetitive dashboard metrics or cards inside cards.
Selected feature has one clear primary action 查看素材 and one supporting 收藏. A small selection tray at the bottom shows 已选素材 and two thumbnail selections with a single download action 下载原文件, keeping the main artwork browse experience dominant. No login or social collaboration features.
All visible additional concept thumbnails must not be falsely labelled SVG. Use no file-format badges on generated new illustration previews, or mark new scene proposals 图片草稿. The known existing source diagrams can have the correct SVG label. No claimed clinical success, validated AI, institutions, paid customers or completed rollout. Keep 'AI辅助' explicitly proposed and human-reviewed when visible.
Clear information hierarchy, comfortable 14–16px body typography, only one or two supporting UI areas, no clipped content. Do not place multiple design options in this image.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Concept name: 选材工作台.
Design one independent, polished Chinese desktop materials library workspace for 心域智链. Target exactly 1440 x 1024, one app screen only, no browser chrome, devices, perspective mockup, phone frame or multiple concepts in one image. This is a UI design concept and has not been implemented.
Intended user: the author of an eight-page university project defense PPT. Goal: choose an actual asset, inspect its size and content, see how it fits one slide, then retrieve its original. The asset library supports PPT authoring, it is not the student/teacher health application. Keep the deck to eight slides. Current date anchor 2026-10-27 Asia/Shanghai, but no date widgets.
Actual references are attached: image 1 grounds existing Open Doodles hand-drawn characters and Phosphor line icons; image 2 grounds project-original mindmap, proposed AI flow and implementation route. Use these as real visual references, not whole-page pasted screenshots. Do not fabricate a new icon family. Use the project’s established pure-white, #78558F warm-purple, #604372 deep-purple, #E8B185 apricot and #8BA696 sage palette, with #29332F text and #56625C secondary text.
This direction is a focused asset-inspection workspace, not a catalog grid. Header: 心域智链 素材工作台, a short breadcrumb 全部素材 / 思维导图, and a compact search. A narrow left vertical asset rail contains only four legible thumbnails and short titles: 项目概览, 拟建AI流程, 实施路径, 师生沟通. Select 项目概览. Do not create an eight-link navigation sidebar or a big gallery like the other layouts.
Main center: a single large white composition area displaying the existing project concept map, elegant lavender connections with no arrowheads for the nonsequential associations, root 心域智链 and four branches 学生使用, 教师支持, 拟建AI辅助, 实施与保障. Each branch has two short correct labels based on the reference. Preserve proposed status for AI. All important text should be readable at the target screen dimensions. Let the map be the dominant visual. A restrained toolbar above the preview has only 原图 and 放入PPT tabs, with 放入PPT selected. Around the actual artwork show a realistic slide composition with its short topic title 项目与服务关系 and generous whitespace; no decorative flourish or preset slide template.
Right side: a slim information column, not a dense settings inspector. Title 项目概览思维导图, short description 用于说明学生、教师与拟建AI的任务关系. Metadata as plain labelled rows: 推荐位置 第3页 产品服务, 原文件 SVG, 编辑源稿 draw.io, 来源 项目原创. Below, a simple placement selector 左图右文 / 居中大图, currently 居中大图. One primary button 下载SVG, one supporting action 查看可编辑源稿. These labels describe existing project files and do not assert new exports.
At bottom of the center, one subtle strip with two compact alternate composition thumbnails showing the same diagram in centered and left-visual arrangements, with short labels. Avoid feature inventories, analytics, fake counts, avatars, user activity, notifications, nested cards, shadows or decorative gradients. Use a restrained desktop editor layout, excellent spacing and refined typography rather than colorful dashboard blocks.
The generated screen is a raster UI concept only. Do not suggest the raster mock itself is a real SVG asset, live canvas or already working feature. No model efficacy, risk prediction, clinical guidance, invented budgets, institutions or completed trials. All support content is project planning, and AI is proposed/human-reviewed.
Natural viewport proportions, Chinese body text around 14–16px, headings comfortably larger, clean alignment. No clipped content and no explanatory captions outside the app UI.
